summary: Implemented the Tabs feature without committing and without running any tests or code. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs); UnderlineBar now yields one Text with clickable_ranges click spans (last, in mapping order) and an early path without click metadata; Opacity merges blended color into the existing style to preserve metadata; _layout_resolve.py gains a concrete LayoutEdge; tests added in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py and new tests/test_tabs.py; docs/reference/tabs.md, sandbox/tabs_demo.py and .css, and a CHANGELOG entry. Decisions: the bar stores the full-list find_tab_by_name index and maps it to the displayed tab by name, so duplicate names still show the underline under the active tab; a zero-width label gets no layout edge because size 0 is read as flexible; inactive spans are wrapped in Opacity individually so the active tab is not dimmed; the click action is built by one shared helper. Unverified: rich 11 keeps Style meta through Style addition and Text.apply_meta(meta, start, end) argument order, and synchronous reactive sets in tests are safe outside a loop. The test suite has not been run and should be run next.
